mentions.name: Wednesday
mentions.description: Wednesday is an AI-powered lead generation platform that lets users request leads directly from Slack for a variety of roles, aimed at smaller sales teams that lack mature CRM tooling.
mentions.problem: Mature sales organizations have in-depth CRMs (e.g., Apollo) that can serve lead generation needs, but smaller teams generally don't; Wednesday fills that gap.
mentions.audience: Smaller sales teams without in-depth CRMs
mentions.source_excerpt:
My business partner and I are building an AI-powered lead gen platform that allows you to request leads directly from Slack for a variety of roles. Most mature sales orgs have really in-depth CRMs that can serve this purpose (Apollo etc) but smaller teams generally don’t. We’re here to fill that gap.

It’s called Wednesday.

Check it out: https://wednes.day
